senses.gloss: (cmp. צבת) [to seize; to bend; cmp. חָפַץ,] with ב, to find pleasure in, to choose, desire.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 34:19">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXIV, 19</cite> (h. text <he>חפץ</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 3:31">Targ. Prov. III, 31</cite> (h. text <he>בחר</he>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 2:21">Targ. O. Ex. II, 21</cite> (h. text <cite ref="J00018"><he>יאל</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 23:6">Targ. Y. Deut. XXIII, 6</cite> (h. text <he>אבה</he>); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 2:4">Targ. Prov. II, 4</cite> <he>תצביה</he>, ed. Wil., v. <cite ref="B01072"><he>בְּצָא</he></cite>.]—Part. <he>צָכֵי</he>; f. <he>צַבְיָא</he>; pl. <he>צָבִין</he>; <cite ref="R00516"><he>צַבְיָין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 11:20">Targ. Prov. XI, 20</cite>. Targ. II Esth. I, 16.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 21:25">Targ. Prov. XXI, 25</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>עפיין</he>, v. <cite ref="P01061"><he>עֲפֵי</he></cite>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 13:1">Tosef. Yeb. XIII, 1</cite> <he>לית היא צביא וכ׳</he> she refuses to be married to him.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 65b:11">Snh. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>דמרי צ׳</he> the master has found pleasure (in that man); <he>שבת נמי מרי צ׳</he> the Sabbath likewise (is distinguished, because) the Lord has chosen it.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:6:7">Y. Keth. VII, 31ᶜ</cite> <he>ולא תִצְבֵּי</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00416"><he>פּוּתְיָא</he></cite>; a. e.
